sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters, including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B parameters per token.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next In this release we are opening the weights of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4. It plays the same role that Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5: the hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design introduced at that time has since been used across the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series.
